build_mega_lra_encoder: build a MegaLRAEncoder instance with configurable embedding type, hidden dimensions, and number of encoder layers
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MegaLRAEncoder with token tensors and source lengths to get inner states and sentence representations
create_embedding_layer: create a sparse or linear Embedding layer for token embeddings with configurable vocab size and embedding dimension
build_mega_sentence_encoder_layer: build a MegaSentenceEncoderLayer with FLASH-based attention, configurable z_dim, n_dim, and relative position bias
review_mega_lra_encoder_forward: review the MegaLRAEncoder forward method to understand padding handling, chunking, and sentence representation extraction via CLS or mean pooling
